decisive_items: right femoral aplasia and left femoral hypoplasia
right unilateral cleft lip and palate
response.rationale: The combination of femoral aplasia/hypoplasia with characteristic facial anomalies (cleft lip/palate, micrognathia) and limb contractures is highly specific for femoral hypoplasia-unusual facies syndrome. Oligohydramnios sequence explains constraint-related deformities but not the femoral aplasia or clefting. Abruptio placentae-related growth restriction does not account for the structural malformations.

rejected.why: Oligohydramnios can cause deformations but not the specific femoral aplasia and cleft lip/palate pattern.
Placental abruption explains growth restriction but not the distinctive skeletal and facial anomalies.
